name: California State Senator

budget.basis: 2026-27 · Total state budget, all funds ($251.5B General Fund), in the Budget Act of 2026, which the Legislature (Senate and Assembly together) passed and the Governor signed June 29, 2026

constituents.basis: Citizens Redistricting Commission ideal Senate district population: 2020 redistricting total of 39,523,437 (Census count with 14,786 federal prisoners removed) divided by 40 districts.

powers.value: Senators introduce and vote on state laws and on the annual budget bill. The Legislature must pass the budget bill by June 15 and can do so by majority vote (Proposition 25, 2010); tax increases still need a two-thirds vote.

term_limit.value: 12 years total in the Legislature, in any combination of Senate and Assembly terms (Proposition 28, 2012), for members first elected after June 7, 2011. The earlier Proposition 140 (1990) limit was 8 years in the Senate and 6 in the Assembly.

notes: The budget figure is the whole state budget, because the Legislature as a body adopts it. Leadership pay effective Dec. 1, 2025: Senate President pro Tem and Minority Floor Leader $154,896; Majority Floor Leader and second-ranking Minority Leader $144,796.
